text:
Ava: Morning — quick async standup. TL;DR: marigold-v2 onboarding getting close, saw a small regression on Spanish long-tail prompts, and a CI reranker failure that might block rollout. Posting what I did / blockers / today.

Ben: Nice, thanks. Quick Q: is the regression consistent on tinyq vs fp16?

Ava: So far it's on both, but worse on tinyq (higher hallucinations). Might be tokenization edgecases for long-span prompts.

Dante: I ran a focused eval overnight against the 1k Spanish promptset. Script:```bash
run_eval --model marigold-v2 --prompts=spanish_longtail.json --report=out.json
```
Results: F1 drop ~6% for reranker pass, top-1 quality down on multi-hop. Attaching brief diff in cloud gist (link omitted).

Eve: Re: reranker CI — looks like the unit test that simulates paired scoring is flaky on CUDA 12.2 kernels. I saw stack: `kernel_compute_score` timeout.

Kai: @Ben can you rebase the PR #4217? CI hit the same flaky test when I merged the quant patch. If we can get a clean run we can isolate if it's quant or kernel change.

Ben: On it, rebasing now. Also will add a short non-flaky integration test that uses smaller inputs to avoid long kernel runs.

Ava: Blocking notes: 1) need clean CI to validate quantization profile; 2) Dante to triage whether prompt normalization fixes issue; 3) fallback plan — route Spanish traffic to marigold-v1 canary if rollout hits SLO.

Dante: I'll try normalizing unicode + aggressive whitespace collapse on the promptset and re-run. ETA 2h.

Eve: For the CUDA kernel flake, I'll add a guard to reduce batch-size in the unit test and open an infra ticket if it still times out.

ci-bot: build #4621 started for commit 9f3b... (marigold-v2/quant).

Ava: Today I'm pairing with Dante on eval inspection, and will draft the rollback routing config for Spanish canary. Also pinging @Kai for a short doc with which model variants are compatible for fallback.

Kai: I'll add a small table to the runbook listing model names, quant profiles, and compatible KV cache behavior. Will post link here when done. :memo:

Ben: Rebased and pushed. CI kicked off: build #4622. If green, I'll run a quick internal canary on staging for the Spanish route.

Dante: Re-run done. Normalization improved F1 by ~2% but didn't fully recover. Dropping a note: longer context (>1024 tokens) still a problem. Might need KV warmup adjustment.

Ava: Good signal. Action items: Dante (investigate KV warmup strategy), Eve (patch test to avoid noisy flakes), Ben (monitor CI + canary), Kai (runbook update), me (routing + decision gate).

Ben: I can also run a small A/B eval comparing marigold-v1 vs v2 on a 500-sample Spanish subset if we want live numbers before any routing decisions.

Ava: Please do that, thanks. If any of you get blocked ping in thread or DM. Quick FYI: I'll be offline 3–4pm PST for meetings but reachable on thread. :wave:

Eve: Noted. Posting infra ticket for CUDA kernel flake: INF-2026.

ci-bot: build #4622 succeeded (9f3b...).

Ben: CI green. Running the A/B now, will post short table. :eyes:

Dante: Following up — I started a small smoke with KV prefill tweak, looks promising locally. Will push a draft config to the canary branch later today.

Ava: Thanks team — good progress.

Ben: A/B done: marigold-v2 top-1 accuracy 0.82, marigold-v1 0.80 on the 500-sample Spanish subset. Sending CSV shortly.

Ava: Nice. We'll hold off rollback for now; decision gate: if traffic-level error rates increase >1.5x over baseline we default to v1. I'll update the rollout gating config.

Kai: Runbook draft posted: (link omitted). Covers fallback names and quant compatibility.

Dante: Draft config pushed to branch `canary/marigold-v2-kvwarmup`.

Ava: Closing the loop — will merge routing change to staging once Ben's canary telemetry is in. If anything regresses we revert via routing. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
